summary_en: How to apply to a Dutch programme from India: institution-set entry requirements, Studielink registration, the 15 January numerus fixus and 1 May general deadlines, and a residence permit your institution files for you.
steps_json: [{"title": "Check the admission requirements for your programme", "body": "The education institution — not a national body — sets the minimum qualification for admission, and Nuffic's diploma recognition service can evaluate your prior qualification. Cambridge English, IELTS, LanguageCert, Pearson, TOEFL iBT and TOEIC are generally accepted as English proof, but the required scores are set per programme, so confirm them with your institution. Preparatory years exist for applicants not yet eligible.", "links": ["https://www.studyinnl.org/plan-your-stay/admission-requirements"]}, {"title": "Find a programme and check how it takes applications", "body": "Search programmes in Studyfinder, then verify with the institution whether it registers you through Studielink: some institutions use a different method for students applying from abroad.", "links": ["https://www.studyinnl.org/dutch-education/studies", "https://www.studyinnl.org/plan-your-stay/how-to-apply"]}, {"title": "Register in Studielink if your institution uses it", "body": "Create a Studielink account and register for the programme.", "links": ["https://www.studielink.nl/"]}, {"title": "Apply before the deadline that applies to your programme", "body": "Numerus fixus programmes close on 15 January at 23:59 CET; other programmes close on 1 May. You may hold at most two numerus fixus applications in a year, and only one for Medicine, Dentistry, Dental Hygiene or Physiotherapy.", "links": ["https://www.studyinnl.org/plan-your-stay/how-to-apply"]}, {"title": "Go through numerus fixus selection, if applicable", "body": "Selection runs between 15 January and 15 April. Your ranking number is published in Studielink on 15 April. Accept an offered place within two weeks or it passes to the next candidate.", "links": ["https://www.studyinnl.org/plan-your-stay/how-to-apply"]}, {"title": "Let your institution arrange the entry visa and residence permit", "body": "Non-EU nationals staying longer than 90 days may need an entry visa (MVV, depending on nationality) and a residence permit (VVR). The host institution starts and submits the application once you enrol — you do not file it yourself. EU nationals need neither a visa nor a work permit. The portal does not publish a proof-of-funds figure, a processing time or a fee.", "links": ["https://www.studyinnl.org/plan-your-stay/do-you-need-a-visa"]}]

summary_en: How to apply to a German programme from India: whether your certificate admits you directly or needs a Studienkolleg, TestDaF/DSH language proof and when it is waived, the uni-assist and Hochschulstart routes and their fees, and the 11,904 euro proof of financing.
steps_json: [{"title": "Check whether your school certificate qualifies you directly", "body": "Recognition depends on your country of origin and falls into four categories: general admission, subject-restricted admission, admission only after one to two years of prior university study at home, or no recognition. If your certificate is judged insufficient you must complete a Studienkolleg foundation course before enrolling. The anabin and ZAB databases record how a given qualification is treated.", "links": ["https://www.study-in-germany.com/en/plan-your-studies/requirements/entrance-qualification/", "https://anabin.kmk.org/no_cache/filter/schulabschluesse-mit-hochschulzugang.html", "https://zab.kmk.org/en/statement-comparability"]}, {"title": "Establish your German language proof, or confirm you are exempt", "body": "TestDaF and the DSH are the tests named by the portal; TestDaF is offered in over 100 countries as a paper-based and digital test. German is not a prerequisite for international degree programmes or certain postgraduate courses, but the portal warns this does not apply everywhere, so ask your institution. No national minimum score or level is published here.", "links": ["https://www.study-in-germany.com/en/plan-your-studies/requirements/german-language-skills/"]}, {"title": "Apply through the right channel and pay its fee", "body": "Applications go through Hochschulstart, uni-assist, or the institution directly, decided by where you took your school-leaving qualification and what you want to study. uni-assist charges 75 euros for the certificate evaluation and first application and 15 euros for each additional application in the same semester; Hochschulstart is free of charge. Your application is only processed once the fee is paid. The portal does not publish national winter- or summer-semester deadlines — the institution's international office holds the document list and dates.", "links": ["https://www.study-in-germany.com/en/plan-your-studies/preparation/application/", "https://www.uni-assist.de/en/", "https://www.hochschulstart.de"]}, {"title": "Prove you can finance your studies", "body": "The standard requirement (Regelbedarf) is 11,904 euros at your disposal for one year. It can be shown by your parents' income and asset documents, a guarantee to the Alien Registration Office by someone with permanent residence in Germany, a deposit into a blocked account, a bank guarantee, or a scholarship award notification from a recognised provider. Confirm which form your German embassy requires before you apply.", "links": ["https://www.study-in-germany.com/en/plan-your-studies/requirements/proof-of-financing/"]}, {"title": "Apply for the student visa", "body": "A prospective student visa (Visum zur Studienbewerbung) is valid for three months and can be extended to six months if you do not yet hold an admission letter. The portal does not state processing times.", "links": ["https://www.study-in-germany.com/en/plan-your-studies/requirements/visa/"]}]

summary_en: How to apply to an Australian course from India: provider-set entry requirements, the Confirmation of Enrolment and compulsory OSHC health cover, and a subclass 500 visa needing AUD 29,710 in financial capacity and the Genuine Student statement.
steps_json: [{"title": "Choose a course and an education provider", "body": "Use the Study Australia Course Search to pick a course, then compare areas of study and locations. If you are not yet eligible, the portal points to university pathway and foundation courses, and to Recognition of Prior Learning for course credits and exemptions.", "links": ["https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-studies/how-to-apply-to-study", "https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-studies/find-a-course", "https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-studies/universities-and-higher-education/pathways-to-university"]}, {"title": "Check entry and English requirements on the provider's own site", "body": "Entry requirements and the English proficiency needed are set by the education provider, so they must be checked on the provider's website. The portal lists the approved language testing organisations rather than a single national score.", "links": ["https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-move/language-testing-organisations"]}, {"title": "Apply to the provider", "body": "Once you have chosen a course you may be able to apply through the education provider's own website; alternatively an education agent can handle the application. The portal states no national application deadline or application fee.", "links": ["https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-studies/how-to-apply-to-study"]}, {"title": "Collect your Confirmation of Enrolment and health cover", "body": "Your provider issues a Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE) verifying your enrolment in a specific course. You must also hold Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC): if you do not provide proof of this insurance, your student visa application will be refused.", "links": ["https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-move/visa-application-process"]}, {"title": "Lodge the subclass 500 student visa through ImmiAccount", "body": "A student visa is needed for any full-time course longer than three months. You lodge it with the Department of Home Affairs through ImmiAccount. You must show financial capacity of at least AUD 29,710, an English proficiency certificate from an approved test, and meet the Genuine Student requirement, which asks about your current circumstances and why you chose this course and Australia. A health examination may be required and a character requirement applies. The portal does not state the visa application fee, processing times, or work-rights hours.", "links": ["https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-move/visa-application-process", "https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-move/your-guide-to-visas"]}]

summary_en: How to apply to a Canadian programme from India: a letter of acceptance from a designated learning institution, the Provincial Attestation Letter (or Quebec CAQ), and a study permit that must be approved before you arrive.
steps_json: [{"title": "Get a letter of acceptance from a designated learning institution", "body": "A letter of acceptance from a designated learning institution (DLI) is among the documents required for the study permit.", "links": ["https://www.educanada.ca/study-plan-etudes/before-avant/permits-visas-permis.aspx?lang=eng"]}, {"title": "Obtain a Provincial Attestation Letter, or a CAQ for Quebec", "body": "A Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) from the province or territory where you plan to study is required. Quebec issues a Quebec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ) instead of a PAL. The portal notes that some exceptions apply, without listing them.", "links": ["https://www.educanada.ca/study-plan-etudes/before-avant/permits-visas-permis.aspx?lang=eng"]}, {"title": "Apply for the study permit before you travel", "body": "You must apply and be approved for a study permit before you arrive in Canada. Alongside the letter of acceptance and the PAL or CAQ you need proof of identity and proof of financial support; fingerprints and a photograph (biometrics) may be required. The portal does not state a proof-of-funds amount or the application fee — the IRCC document checklist carries the full list.", "links": ["https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/get-documents.html", "https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/apply.html"]}, {"title": "Check the processing time for your country", "body": "Processing times vary by country and are published by IRCC rather than fixed on the study portal.", "links": ["https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/check-processing-times.html"]}]

title_en: Studying agriculture in the United States
summary_en: The EducationUSA five steps applied from India: researching institutions, financing, an application typically due November to January for a September start, the F/J/M student visa, and pre-departure compliance.
steps_json: [{"title": "Research your options", "body": "EducationUSA frames US study as five steps, the first being to learn the range of options and identify an institution that fits: community college, undergraduate, graduate, short-term, English language, or online study.", "links": ["https://educationusa.state.gov/your-5-steps-us-study/research-your-options"]}, {"title": "Finance your studies", "body": "Explore funding options and the university financial aid opportunity list.", "links": ["https://educationusa.state.gov/your-5-steps-us-study/finance-your-studies"]}, {"title": "Complete your application", "body": "Applications generally require educational credentials (diplomas, transcripts, national exams), standardized test scores covering academic ability and English proficiency, recommendation letters from school officials, teachers or supervisors, and an essay about your interests and goals. US undergraduate applications are typically due between November and January to begin courses the following September. Requirements vary greatly between institutions, and EducationUSA names no specific test or minimum score — check each institution.", "links": ["https://educationusa.state.gov/your-5-steps-us-study/complete-your-application/undergraduate"]}, {"title": "Apply for your student visa", "body": "US study uses the F, J and M visa types. EducationUSA directs applicants to the State Department and DHS resources for the requirements rather than listing them itself, and does not state the SEVIS fee. Its own advice: visa interviews are short, so be ready to explain why you want to study in the United States, how you will support yourself, and your plans after your studies finish.", "links": ["https://educationusa.state.gov/your-5-steps-us-study/apply-your-student-visa", "https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/study.html", "https://studyinthestates.dhs.gov/students"]}, {"title": "Prepare for your departure", "body": "Pre-departure preparation covers gathering the documents needed on arrival and immigration compliance.", "links": ["https://educationusa.state.gov/your-5-steps-us-study/prepare-your-departure"]}]
